event_name: Oktoberfest Tap Takeover w 3 Festbiers on tap
date_text: Thu, Oct 8th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Oct 11th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: Oktoberfest is back at Hotel Sweeneys and what a great lineup!! Some absolute classics , and some worth hunting out, as well as some Festbier direct from the source. Prost! Tap List: - Weltenburger Festbier - Andechs Festbier - Rothaus Pils - Weltenburger Dunkel - Aktien Landbier Kellerbier - Aktien Landbier 1857 Golden Lager - Bayreuther Hell - Maisel's Weisse Original - Fruh Kolsch - HB Original - HB Oktoberfest - HB Maibock - HB Hefe - HB Dunkel
